content:
As the European Union implements new transparency requirements for AI-generated content, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that allows channel administrators to label certain types of AI-generated content. Details are as follows.

"Channel administrators in your country/region are required to add labels to channel updates that use AI-generated content"

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing a feature that lets channel administrators mark certain types of content as AI-generated.

References to the new feature have appeared in the latest WhatsApp beta for Android, but since the feature appears to be designed in response to regulatory requirements in specific countries/regions, an iOS version and a broader rollout are expected to follow later.

According to the report, the new feature will follow the same workflow channel administrators use when posting sponsored content:

WABetaInfo points out that not all AI-generated content needs to be labelled. Based on the description in the current launch screen, AI content includes images, videos or other media created or edited using AI tools.

In other words, administrators do not appear to need to label AI-generated text content. It remains unclear whether this option will be rolled out globally, or only available in regions where the law requires such labelling.
